description: Recipe collection following schema.org/Recipe standard. All recipes tested and macro-tracked.

recipes.name: Batch Baked Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs. Crispy skin, juicy meat. Foundation protein for the week.

yield.unit: portions (5.5 oz cooked, skinless meat each)

nutrition.basis: 156 g cooked skinless thigh meat; USDA FDC 172388 (roasted, meat only). Eating the skin adds about 60 kcal and 5 g fat per portion.

ingredients.note: bone, skin and cook loss leave roughly 40% as cooked skinless meat, so 12 lb gives about 4.8 lb, or 14 portions of 5.5 oz
about 3/4 tsp Diamond Crystal per lb; use less table salt

instructions.instruction: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line two sheet pans with foil.
Pat chicken completely dry with paper towels (essential for crispy skin)
Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, cayenne in a bowl
Season all pieces generously on both sides
Distribute evenly on two pans (don't crowd them)
Bake 38-42 minutes. Done when skin is golden-brown and juices run clear
Rest 5 minutes. Cool on pans before refrigerating

recipes.notes: Bone-in thighs stay juicy even if slightly overcooked. Pull at 175F, not 165F: dark meat is more tender at the higher temperature (165F is the safe minimum). Scale the seasoning to 12 lb (roughly 2.4x the amounts listed in the seasoning table if you use the 5 lb rub). Swap rubs from data/seasonings.json to vary the week.

recipes.name: Batch Browned Ground Beef
recipes.description: Quick-cooked bulk ground beef. Versatile protein for bowls, tacos, pasta.

instructions.instruction: Heat large skillet over medium-high heat. No oil needed.
Add meat in one layer if possible
Let sit 1-2 minutes undisturbed to brown the bottom
Break apart with spatula and continue cooking
Cook until no pink remains, approximately 8-10 minutes total
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Tilt pan and spoon off excess fat (or drain in colander)
Cool before refrigerating

recipes.name: Batch Cooked Rice
recipes.description: Perfect white rice. Cheapest carbs in the system. Cook in bulk for the week.

instructions.instruction: Rinse rice in strainer under cold water for 30 seconds
Add rice, water, and salt to pot with tight-fitting lid
Bring to boil over high heat
Reduce to lowest setting and cover immediately
Cook for exactly 18 minutes. Do not lift lid.
Remove from heat and let sit covered for 5 more minutes
Fluff with fork. Spread on sheet pan to cool before storing.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats + PB + Whey
recipes.description: High-protein breakfast. Make 7 jars Sunday. Grab and go every morning.

instructions.instruction: Add oats, milk, yogurt, and whey to mason jar or container
Stir vigorously until well combined
Stir in peanut butter
Add banana slices
Seal and refrigerate overnight
Morning: eat cold or microwave 60-90 seconds. Add milk if too thick.

recipes.notes: Make 7 jars on batch day for the entire week. No prep needed in the morning.

recipes.name: PB Banana Power Shake
recipes.description: Quick protein shake. 90 seconds from blender to glass.

instructions.instruction: Add milk and whey protein to blender first (liquid at bottom)
Add banana, peanut butter, and ice on top
Blend on high for 45-90 seconds until smooth

recipes.name: Lentil Bean Chili
recipes.description: CHEAPEST meal in the system. Highest protein. Freezes for months.

instructions.instruction: Sauté onion, pepper, and garlic in large pot for 2 minutes
Add spices (cumin, chili powder, cinnamon) and cook 15 seconds
Add canned tomatoes, water, and brown lentils. Bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add kidney beans and corn, cook 5 more minutes
Off heat, stir in red lentils and cover for 15 minutes
Serve with lime and cilantro

recipes.name: Chicken Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Assembly meal from the batch components. Numbers are computed from USDA values, not estimated.

nutrition.basis: 156 g roasted skinless thigh (279 kcal) + 1 cup white rice (205) + 1/2 cup veg (30) + soy-honey sauce (51)

instructions.instruction: Layer rice, chicken and vegetables in a microwave-safe container
Drizzle soy sauce and honey
Microwave 90 seconds, stir, then 30 seconds more until steaming hot (165F)

recipes.notes: Swap the sauce or rub from data/seasonings.json to change the flavor without changing the macros much. Swap the meat: breast is about 30 kcal and 8 g protein different per portion, see data/ingredients.json.

recipes.name: Batch Boneless Skinless Thighs
recipes.description: Faster, easier-to-portion dark meat. Costs about twice as much per pound as bone-in but nothing is wasted.

instructions.instruction: Heat oven to 425F. Line a sheet pan with parchment or foil.
Pat thighs dry, toss with oil and rub, and spread in one layer with space between
Roast 20-25 minutes until 175F in the thickest part
Rest 5 minutes, cool within 2 hours and refrigerate

recipes.notes: Overcooking past about 175F dries boneless thighs. Cooks in about half the time of bone-in.

recipes.name: Batch Poached Chicken Breast
recipes.description: The juiciest way to batch lean breast. Ideal for rice bowls, salads and shredding.

nutrition.basis: 170 g cooked; USDA FDC 171477 (roasted breast; poached is similar)

instructions.instruction: Place breasts in one layer in a pot; cover with cold water and add salt, garlic and pepper
Bring to a bare simmer over medium heat, then cover and turn heat off
Let stand 15-18 minutes until the thickest part reads 165F
Slice or shred. Store with a spoonful of the poaching broth to stay moist.

recipes.notes: Very large breasts (over 10 oz) may need up to 25 minutes off heat, or cut them in half.

recipes.name: Batch Roasted Drumsticks
recipes.description: Cheapest per gram of protein when on sale. Forgiving and needs no trimming.

nutrition.basis: about 204 g cooked meat and skin per 1 lb raw; USDA FDC 173612. Peel the skin to drop about 8-10 g fat.

ingredients.item: baking powder (aluminum-free), optional for crisp skin

instructions.instruction: Heat oven to 425F with a rack over a sheet pan
Pat dry very well, toss with baking powder, salt and rub
Roast on the rack, turning once, 35-45 minutes until 175F
Rest, cool, and refrigerate within 2 hours

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Salsa Chicken (shredded)
recipes.description: Set-and-forget shredded chicken for burritos, bowls and tacos.

nutrition.basis: chicken only; salsa adds about 10 kcal per 2 tbsp

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

instructions.instruction: Add chicken, salsa and seasoning to the slow cooker
Cook LOW 2.5-3.5 hours for breast, 4-5 hours for thigh, until 165F+ and tender
Shred with two forks and stir back into the juices

recipes.notes: Breast overcooks quickly; check early. Thighs can go longer without drying.

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Taco Meat
recipes.description: Fast batch protein for burrito bowls; 93/7 turkey stays moist with a little broth.

nutrition.basis: raw 93/7 turkey at 150 kcal, 18.7 g protein, 8.3 g fat per 100 g, divided by 4; some fat is lost when cooked

instructions.instruction: Heat a skillet over medium-high; add turkey and leave 1-2 minutes to brown
Break apart and cook until no pink remains and it reaches 160F, about 8 minutes
Stir in seasoning and broth, simmer 2 minutes

recipes.notes: Use 80/20 beef here and drain half the fat if you want more flavor; 90/10 and 93/7 need the added liquid.

recipes.name: Batch Hard-Boiled Eggs
recipes.description: Cheapest quick protein. About 6 g per large egg.

nutrition.basis: one large egg (50 g) from 143 kcal, 12.6 g protein, 9.5 g fat per 100 g

instructions.instruction: Lower eggs into boiling water with a spoon
Boil 11-12 minutes
Move to an ice bath 5 minutes. Refrigerate in the shell.

recipes.notes: USDA: hard-boiled eggs keep 1 week refrigerated; do not freeze.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Budget meal from batch rice and frozen vegetables. Day-old rice works best.

nutrition.basis: 3 eggs + 1.5 cup cooked rice + 1/2 cup veg + 1 tsp oil + soy

instructions.instruction: Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat; scramble eggs until just set and push aside
Add vegetables, cook 2 minutes; add rice, breaking up clumps
Fry 3-4 minutes until hot, stir in soy sauce and eggs

nutrition.basis: 5 oz can light tuna in water (113 g drained) + 1 cup rice + 1/2 cup veg + soy-honey

ingredients.item: canned light tuna in water, drained

instructions.instruction: Drain tuna well; put rice in a bowl and top with tuna and vegetables
Drizzle with soy and honey and mix

recipes.name: Pre-Race / Long-Run Carb Bowl
recipes.description: Low fat, low fiber, high carbohydrate meal for the day before or 3-4 h before a marathon or long run. Familiar foods only.

nutrition.basis: 1.5 cups white rice (237 g) + 3 oz poached breast + 1 tbsp honey. For a runner around 70 kg, 1-4 g/kg pre-race carbs is 70-280 g, so scale the rice up to about 3-4 cups for the larger meals.

instructions.instruction: Combine warm rice and chicken, drizzle with honey and soy, and salt lightly
Eat 3-4 hours before the start, or as dinner the night before

recipes.notes: Practise this exact meal before a long run. See data/fueling.json for the carb-load and race-fueling numbers (ISSN).

recipes.name: Batch Sheet Pan Potatoes
recipes.description: Cheap alternative carb to rice; roasts in the oven alongside the chicken.

nutrition.basis: 3 lb russet (about 1,360 g raw, 79 kcal per 100 g) + 2 tbsp oil, divided by 8

instructions.instruction: Heat oven to 425F. Cut potatoes into 3/4 inch pieces.
Toss with oil and seasoning; spread on a sheet pan in one layer
Roast 30-35 minutes, flipping once, until golden and tender
